description: This file defines the SchedulerBackend trait, an interface for scheduling systems in Apache Spark, including methods for managing tasks, retrieving application info, and handling shuffle locations.

classes.name: SchedulerBackend
classes.description: An interface for Spark's scheduling backend, providing methods for task management, resource handling, and application info.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the scheduler backend with an exit code.

methods.name: updateExecutorsLogLevel
methods.description: Updates the log level for executors.

methods.name: reviveOffers
methods.description: Updates resource offers and schedules tasks.

methods.name: defaultParallelism
methods.description: Returns the default level of parallelism.

methods.name: killTask
methods.description: Requests termination of a specific task on an executor.

methods.name: getTaskThreadDump
methods.description: Retrieves thread dump for a specific task.

methods.name: isReady
methods.description: Checks if the backend is ready.

methods.name: applicationAttemptId
methods.description: Returns the application attempt ID if available.

methods.name: getDriverAttributes
methods.description: Provides driver attributes for log URL replacement.

methods.name: maxNumConcurrentTasks
methods.description: Calculates maximum concurrent tasks based on ResourceProfile.

methods.name: getShufflePushMergerLocations
methods.description: Returns locations for push-based shuffle services.
